newsitem.title: USA: American woman gives birth to 2nd set of triplets.
newsitem.headline: American woman gives birth to 2nd set of triplets.

text.p: Mother's Day was extra special this year for an American woman who was nursing her second set of newly-born triplets.

Paula Robinson, 34, had her first set of triplets -- two girls and a boy -- 12 years ago, and the second set -- two boys and a girl -- arrived on Friday at St. Agnes Hospital in Baltimore, FOX News reported on Sunday.

Robinson, from Pasadena, Maryland, told the network that coping with the babies' arrival should be easier this time around, since she had just separated from her first husband shortly before her three older triplets were born.
Besides, this time, the older children have agreed to help babysit.
Robinson, who runs a daycare centre, called the babies' arrival "the greatest gift of all. My three miracles and the first three."
Her second husband, Jeffrey Robinson, says he'll have to work hard to help support the newly doubled family. "We'll make it," he told the network.
